notes.title: Give Us Your Feedback
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

At Detallion Games we constantly want to improve our future games. We would love to hear more of your feedback.

Let us know what positively surprised you in Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III 
And what did you not like during the game. (Yes, we heard about difficulty in some riddles)

notes.title: The new mode
notes.content:
Why is there a new mode in Nemezis?

We present to you the mode in which we extracted the essence of the game. 
[list]
[*] Puzzles alone
[*] No narration
[*] No other characters
[*] No dialogues or monologues 
[/list]

Just you and the brain-teasers. 
The idea is based on your opinions and requests. We are aware that this is not a mode for everyone :)

Who wants to try?!

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
We always listen to your feedback and as a result we're happy to introduce a new game mode!

This update contains a third game mode that offers hard puzzles while having no plot whatsoever. No characters, no narrative, just the puzzles. We have also extended the log window so more text can appear on the screen at once.

notes.title: Memories
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/d975b0fb372eaedc1543e003afb63c85201ca9ac.png[/img]

Why are we inspired by the game [i]Myst[/i]? 

Because we consider it a groundbreaking game. [i]Myst[/i] was released in 1993 and it's amazing what could be achieved even back then.

We recommend this game and our challenging puzzle.

Which of these statements isn't true?
[list]
[*] [i]Myst[/i] had been the best-selling game of all time until 2002, when [i]The Sims[/i] jumped on the first place. For a few years, it stayed on PC Data's top ten list. 
[*] In 1999, Disney execs considered turning Walt Disney World's Discovery Island into an interactive Myst adventure, complete with puzzles, treasure hunting, and the island's familiar layout of buildings. 
[*] [i]Myst[/i] could be played only in the full moon.
[*] [i]Myst[/i] was made by the Cyan team entirely on stock color Macintoshes using Stratavision Software, Macromedia MacroModel, and Photoshop. The result was more than 2500 rendered images players could interact with individually. Until the success of the game, Cyan was run from the basement.
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/3caa654ba7ea8834c53908e55301974be42b5ecf.gif[/img]

Sources: 
https://www.mentalfloss.com/article/63351/15-things-you-might-not-know-about-myst
https://www.mobygames.com/game/macintosh/myst

Why is Schizm: Mysterious Journey (2001) so close to our hearts?

[b]It’s because of Roland Pantoła. [/b]His brain powers gained from working with Schizm he now used to design Nemezis. Do you remember all those classic games like Schizm, Myst, or Reah (it was thousands of years ago)? Here is the super difficult quiz to fresh your mind.

[b]How many spots are in the Schizm: Mysterious Journey where you can make a complete turn and go in several directions of your choice?[/b]
a) 3
b) 10
c) 11
d) 969

[b]What is the name of the planet where Hannah and Sam landed?[/b]
a) Mars
b) HD 219134 b
c) Argilus
d) Crispy Planet

“Breathtaking, highly detailed, photorealistic, 3D prerendered graphics presented fullscreen in high resolution and high color (65k colors)” (from producer site). 

[b]What was the resolution of the game?[/b]
a) 1920 x 1080
b) 1280 x 1024

notes.title: Birds of (Regilus) Paradise – Contest Announcement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/0d42f379b1a45bf608a5090730800dbe76f41153.png[/img]

[b]Why so many birds on Regilus?[/b]

At first, there were to be no animals on Regilus. We wanted to focus on vegetation. But one day our lead graphic designer, Robert (hi, Robert! We love you!), asked if he could add one or two birds to the game. 

We thought: why not? One or two birds? Cool! 

And... that's how it started. The birds took over the first level of the game (which you can enjoy in 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1636350/Nemezis_Mysterious_Journey_III_Prologue/][b]Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III Prologue[/b][/url]). They were both here and there. Here, there, here and there. It was slowly starting to resemble The Birds by Alfred Hitchcock. We said: please, stop! 

But... Robert's vision became slightly hazy and he was repeating: Just. One. More. Tiny. Bird... Just one more…

It took us a while, but we got the situation under control. As you can see, there aren't THAT many birds in the Prologue. That's right! [b]How MANY are there? Who can find them all?[/b] Write your answers in the comments below the post!

Those who manage to do so will be rewarded with a free game of Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III (to be released on July 8!). You have time till the premiere of the game. So - happy birds watching!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/6b6756e94c1a028c81fa9d08f834bb788e5d8042.gif[/img]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/d76b8976547c1861624cea90350d374956f6fe0d.png[/img]

Hello, Travelers.

Today we come to you with another fascinating news!

The Management Board of Detalion Games S.A. informs that the Company [b]plans to publish on May 27, 2021 on the Steam platform a free prologue to the game Nemesis: Mysterious Journey III.[/b]

[b]Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III Prologue is the first level of the adventure and logical science fiction game Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III.[/b] Recipients can learn about the game mechanics and its world.

The publication of the prologue is part of the Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III marketing campaign and precedes its premiere, scheduled for July 8, 2021.

More information can be found [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1636350/Nemezis_Mysterious_Journey_III_Prologue/?utm_source=Steam&utm_medium=banner&utm_campaign=post_19_05]HERE[/url][/b].

Are you excited? Because we do!

Don't forget to add it to your wishlist and stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Travelers, an important information for you!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/133e255ebb541076b7a68b5d138754ff1895f213.png[/img]

Hello, our Dear Travelers!

Today we come to you with [b]important information about the release date of our game.[/b]

The Management Board of DETALION GAMES S.A. informs that today a decision has been made to postpone the release date of the PC version of the game Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III to [b]July 8, 2021.
[/b]
The Management Board of the Company made the above decision [b]due to the Steam Next Festival[/b] (festival of game demos) held on June 16, 2021 - June 22, 2021, which could potentially adversely affect the sale of the game at a pre-selected date (June 17).

See you soon!

notes.title: Guide to Regilus vol. 2 - Meet the electronic guide
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/5a36ab3b33c7a6bfa297089ef2c5cceeb5a75487.png[/img]

Hello, Travelers!

[b]There's more information ahead that will help you prepare for your journey to the mysterious Regilus.[/b]

You already know that to get to the planet, you'll have to use a teleportation booth. And this is where the question of what to do next comes in. Where to go, what to explore and generally what to do.

[b]An electronic guide will help you.[/b] You get it at the start and it will accompany you for the rest of your adventure. And here it is. How do you like this travel aid? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/c08a267ba7d3f41187302676641b97cd70c6b65b.png[/img]

[b]But remember, it's not always worth trusting a guide completely.[/b] It's best to rely on your own brain and observation skills.

Soon another dose of useful information!

See you soon!

notes.title: Guide to Regilus vol. 1 - How to get to the planet?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/8da1a9b15b0ea3f608acf25ea20ae57bf4282238.png[/img]

As for any trip, you need to be well prepared, so we come to you with a [b]series of guides that will help you plan your trip to Regilus.[/b]

So… let's start with how to get there. Since this is an interplanetary journey, the traditional methods of transport are eliminated ... No by car, no by train, not even by plane. So how? Capsule, shuttle, rocket? Well no... The only way is to teleport... Yes, you got it right... [b]You're going to be teleported.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/b606e64535ff49273436a76bbeaf8625f0812de0.gif[/img]

You must prepare for an extraordinary journey! [b]Probably many of you haven't tried it yet, but don't be afraid! Traveling in the teleportation cabin is completely safe and takes literally a moment.[/b] Before you know it, you'll be there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/d36317f3aed669abc4287f4318f66c2ecb317c6f.png[/img]

You can take your luggage with you, it will not bother you in anything. And, of course, a good mood!

See you soon in the next guide!

notes.title: Nemezis: Mysterious III not only for PC

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/f14d7469f2a940ea0ee11338e675290c5fb936ba.png[/img]

notes.title: Puzzles. Try to solve them
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/4e04099645c706f51562f561efef817ea7928b47.png[/img]

Hello again!

You already know some facts about our game. You have already met the creators, characters, the planet where the action takes place - Regilus - and you also had the opportunity to play the demo on Steam. Now it's time to bring you some puzzles.
[b]
Puzzles, in addition to amazing graphics, is a hallmark of our game. [/b]Their originator is Roland Pantoła – the lead designer of the game Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III. So let's start with the fact that there are different levels of puzzles. With simpler puzzles such as those over which you will need to head a little. On the normal level you will find a hint system that will tell you how to solve the puzzle. On the other hand, on a hard level to solve the puzzle, we will have to find it ourselves. 

[b]Compared to the previous Roland Pantoła games, we have a novelty here. [/b]In the game there are puzzles that have a specific structure. What's the thing? Well, they consist in the fact that somewhere in the level there are additional objects - three, sometimes four - in which the player must figure out how the right object works. Getting to know the smaller puzzles determines the solution of the main puzzle. This can be setting elements, choosing a color or how it works.

We are convinced that they will appeal to fans of the genre and solving them will bring them a lot of fun and satisfaction.

You will soon be able to find out about it.

And for now, we encourage you to follow our social media activity and add our game to your wishlist.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: There would be no Nemezis if it wasn’t for...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/56315f31259f1166c589dd6377c58daa1d56eba0.png[/img]

There are some people without whom certain things wouldn't happen. It is no different in the case of Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III. He probably doesn't need to be introduced to most of you, but if you haven't had the pleasure of meeting the [b]"father" of Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III[/b] project yet, you have a chance to do it now. Who are we talking about? About [b]Roland Pantoła[/b]... 

Computer game developer, designer and graphic designer. One of the pioneers of the computer games industry in Poland creating games since the early 90s. Key person in the Detalion company operating in 2002-2006. Roland has a very rich experience covering complex tasks connected with game production - author's works (creation of entirely own games) or partial works connected with other titles, programming, designing or graphic tasks. 

Soon you will be able to play his latest production Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III. In the meantime, we encourage you to play the demo and let us know how you like it! Oh, and most importantly, don't forget to add the game to your wishlist! 

Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Welcome to Regilus
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/9187fdb221e8fd87c02bdec9484f87cc359a8bbb.png[/img]

[b]The main place of action in our game is the planet Regilus.[/b] An extremely atmospheric place. A beautiful and dark world at the same time. It has long electrified with its mystery and attracted the attention of those who wanted to do business here. Some of the first interested parties were groups of colonizers and private galactic explorers. Fighting for influence, they invested money in the exploration of Regilus. However, their efforts turned out to be futile, because the deposits of rare minerals were too small to make money on them.

After them, Travel Agencies sensed their chance for business. Yes, you got it right - Travel Agencies. After all, why not use the potential and picturesque scenery of Regilus and turn it into a tourist attraction? Certainly there would be many people willing to go on such an adventure.

As you probably remember, one of these services was used by our main characters - Amia and Bogard, who after arriving at Regilus are separated and in order to find each other, they will have to face many intriguing puzzles of varying complexity.

[b]The journey through Regilus consists of seven different locations that will surely provide visitors with an amazing experience. [/b]You will find here, among others:

- [b]Underground [/b]- the darkest corners of Regilus. No lights, wet, shrouded in fog,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/bc55915c6c22ee3175ecbbe8ab40fe34245fefde.png[/img]

- [b]Clouds[/b] - the action takes place... in the clouds... A characteristic feature of this land are stationary balloons suspended under the sky,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/13ef48f8cac29d7551ba49e23a194657faa56cd0.png[/img]

- [b]Towers[/b] - amazing structures, connected with each other by steel bridges,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/e452bcc461f6f500855e66f69f99b0b83e3a7817.png[/img]

- [b]Seaside City[/b] - vacation by the sea? Why not! Welcome to Seaside City, a coastal land whose center is a mysterious windmill structure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/d10a6f825702bed21396798a59761a1cb6e8a5c2.png[/img]

Of course, these are just some of the lands on Regiulus. You'll know more soon after the premiere. But now let us know and write in comment, which one you like best!

Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Meet our characters
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/618b1a2928b40e8e06fd0cee453a724037e2550f.png[/img]

Hello again! 

Who among us has not dreamed of a journey filled with many adventures. Well. . . We think probably everyone. It's no different for our main characters. [b]Meet Amia and Bogard, the protagonists of 'Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III'. [/b]

They have many differences, Amia - calm and balanced, Bogard - impulsive and impatient. They have two things in common - high IQ and passion for travel.

Unfortunately, they aren't given a peaceful rest and the opportunity to enjoy the beautiful scenery. Right after teleporting to Regilus, the heroes are separated and in order to find each other they have to solve a number of puzzles, which certainly aren't the easiest ones. Well, you have to admit that the inhabitants of the planet went to a lot of trouble to make it difficult for the newcomers to move around the planet. It's worth adding that the adventures of our heroes are accompanied by a mysterious electronic guide, whose behaviour may be crucial in certain situations.

How will Amia and Bogard's stay on Regilus end? Will the characters manage to solve the mysteries and find each other? And actually, what do Amia and Bogard have in common? Who are our characters to each other? You can find out all this by playing our game - 'Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III'. The premiere is coming soon. 

In the meantime we remind you about the free opportunity to play the demo. You can find it for download on our Steam page!

Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: FAQ
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/c43b1dab7e5e0047085ecf575b472c2e473dcf5e.png[/img]

Hello, Players! 

We have prepared for you answers to the most [b]frequently asked questions[/b]. You will find the answers below.

[b]1. What is ‘Nemezis: Misterious Journey 3’?[/b]
‘Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III’ is an puzzle-adventure and logical game in which two tourists - Bogard and Amia - become entangled in a mysterious intrigue. Solve intriguing puzzles and experience the suspenseful plot to the very end.

[b]2. When will the game be released?[/b]
The game will be released in the first quarter of 2021.

[b]3. How much will the game cost?[/b]
Our game will cost around $ 20.

[b]4. What platforms will this game be available on?[/b]
At the beginning, we plan to release the game on PC platforms. First of all, Steam. But we aren’t rejecting the console ports.

[b]5. What engine is the game made on?[/b]
This engine is Unreal.

[b]6. Will there be beta testing? If so, how will it be possible to apply to them?[/b]
No, we don’t plan beta testing. 

[b]7. Are you planning any demo or prologue?[/b]
Maybe it will be a surprise for you, but the demo is available now. You can find it on our Steam page [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/986350/Nemezis_Mysterious_Journey_III/][b]HERE[/b][/url].

[b]8. Are you planning any more parts of the game?[/b]
Yes, we plan. We have a lot of ideas, but of course it all depends on whether the players take the first part well.

[b]9. Where can I find more information about the game?[/b]
More information about the game can be found on our Steam page. You can find it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/986350/Nemezis_Mysterious_Journey_III/][b]HERE[/b][/url].

notes.title: Some info about us
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34022690/78edc0162607fde8c0ea0ec4e9d111668069cb90.png[/img]

Hello there! 

Today we would like to present you some information about our studio.

Detalion Games is a polish AA game development studio, established in 2018. Our core team consists of people who have been working in this industry for many years, since the 1990s. We want to make games with "old soul" but in the new technology. Detalion Games is currently working on our first big puzzle-adventure game: Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III, to be published in the first quarter of 2021.

We also remind you that you can download the demo of Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III from our Steam page.

Stay tuned for more!
